items.author: Matthias Smider, World Cup scouting app built as a Tableau Data App, Nov 13
items.summary: A Tableau solution engineer built a World Cup 2026 player-scouting app with Tableau Data Apps and Claude: FIFA-style player cards, KPI views and a hidden retro penalty-shootout game. 3 reactions.

items.author: Maureen Schley, "Dinder" meal-swiping Data App, Nov 12
items.summary: A Tableau solutions engineer built a swipe-to-pick dinner app as a Tableau Data App with Claude in about an hour. 48 reactions, 9 comments, 2 reposts.

items.author: Will Sutton, Tour de France viz rebuilt as a Data App, Nov 12
items.summary: The Iron Viz champion rebuilt his five-year-old Tour de France viz as a Tableau Data App, with scroll storytelling still in progress. 47 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.

items.author: Steve Adams, "What is a Tableau data app?" in plain words, Nov 13
items.summary: Short video explainer contrasting dashboards with data apps; his app was built from a paper sketch with Claude and Tableau MCP, runs on Tableau Cloud (beta), and can't be built in Desktop yet. 3 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.

items.author: Ilya Fedorkov, Claude dashboard on a Power BI semantic model via MCP, Nov 12
items.summary: Claude builds a dashboard on a Power BI semantic model through its MCP endpoint: every figure shows its DAX, row-level security still applies, and the page can write a forecast back to the model. 33 reactions, 7 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Guy in a Cube, Power BI Desktop Bridge for AI agents, Nov 12
items.summary: The new Power BI Desktop Bridge lets AI agents screenshot and reload reports to check their own work, with the caveat that verification isn't the same as quality. 243 reactions, 8 comments, 5 reposts.

items.author: Luca Deluca, interactive dashboard on his own chess games, Nov 12
items.summary: A BI data engineer turned roughly 7,000 of his own chess games into an interactive dashboard on his site. 14 reactions, 2 comments. [Dashboard](https://lnkd.in/exGuHt5G)
